description: Tiny realized discovery tree used to calibrate replay policies. Scores are infrastructure utility scores, not scientific truth probabilities.

attempts.observation: State could be written, but no matched order-control receipt existed yet.
Useful for inspection but did not improve scientific executability.
The matched frozen-write arm collapses the order effect.
Recorded discovery can now be traversed under alternative exploration policies without rerunning experiments.
The proposer recovered the coordinate-learnability boundary and a matched attacker set, but correctly refused execution because three adapters were missing.

All eight frozen gates passed across the eight-world synthetic panel. The result supports learnability in a PCA-friendly matched recurrent family and leaves online/local learning plus coordinate drift open.
